caption:
🍓 Strawberry Shortcakes 🍓 

Ingredients
-200 grams Maida 
-35 grams caster sugar
-2 tsp baking powder ( it needs to be aluminum free, urban platter is good here) 
-salt, a pinch
-50 grams, unsalted butter, cubed and frozen for 30 minutes
-50 ml heavy cream
-1 tsp vanilla

1-2 tbsp cream, to brush on the tops before baking

Method: 
-sift together the maida, sugar, baking powder and salt
-add your cubed butter to the mix and using a cutter, cut the butter into the flour! If you do not have one you can use two forks or your hands as well 
-add the heavy cream and vanilla in two parts gently mixing together till you have a shabby dough as shown in the video 
-dust some flour on your worktop and place the dough 
-roll the dough till it is 1/2 inch ish thick 
-using a cutter, cut circles out you should get around 6-7 depending on the size of your cutter I use a 3.5 inch here 
-place on your baking sheet and refrigerate for 10-15 minutes while you pre heat the oven to 190 degrees
-bake the shortcake for 15-20 minutes till they are nice and golden brown 
-allow to cool and assemble with whipped cream and macerated strawberries
-enjoy fresh :)
